setting.name: Disable Audio Ducking
setting.casual_explanation: This sets the Windows communications ducking preference so the system does not reduce other audio volumes during calls.
setting.why_people_change_it: People change it when they do not want Windows to lower media volume automatically during communications activity.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: The single-value control is straightforward, but the card still lives only in the first-party provider and has not been promoted into the validated research-provider surface.
setting.professional_notes: The current app still exposes this tweak through app/Services/TweakProviders/AudioTweakProvider.cs and engine/Tweaks/Peripheral/AudioTweaks.cs. The current engine tweak writes UserDuckingPreference=3 on the current user profile. This record keeps the live behavior documented without publishing it as a validated research-provider card yet.
